info.name: AlayaCare Accounting Accounts Visit interventions API
Get a list of interventions for a visit using it's Alayacare ID

params.name: is_required
params.description: Filter for interventions that are required to finish a visit

params.name: has_comment
params.description: Filter for interventions that have a comment or not_completed_reason_name

params.name: is_completed
params.description: Filter for interventions that have been completed

items.docs: Get a list of interventions for a visit using it's Alayacare ID

- The full list of Interventions must be provided in the request body, it will override the previously available list.
- Only active `interventions` on the patient active Careplan can be added
- Only the admin user can update the visit interventions when the work session is not open.

info.name: Update interventions in a visit using it's Alayacare ID

items.docs:
- The full list of Interventions must be provided in the request body, it will override the previously available list.
- User credentials MUST have an admin role.
- (Employee internal id) MUST be informed on the url path as a param, like this: '?completions_by={employee_internal_id}'.
- Position should be always 0. It does not cover the interventions tries.
- The Employee '?completions_by={employee_internal_id} must be clocked-in to the visit.
